description: Datasets for Occupancy Profiles in Student Housing for Occupant Behavior Studies and Application in Building Energy Simulation is published by Mendeley. It describes minute-level entry and exit observations from 41 student volunteers at Clarkson University during part of 2018. Coverage is site within US. Spatial detail: Clarkson University student housing. Temporal coverage: 4 February–10 May 2018, excluding breaks and invalid days. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Data format is not established in the metadata reviewed. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Cost is uncertain; the on_request value flags the need to obtain terms, not a verified price or provider requirement. The study recruited 41 volunteers but excluded five participants. The retained dataset contains 1,096 daily schedules after removing invalid or uncertain days. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
